data.title: 胡桃 · 红木书案的墨香与绯红微醺
data.description: 往生堂深处的堂主书房内，窗外竹影摇曳。胡桃端坐在光洁厚重的红木书案边缘，一身利落修身的黑红相间短旗袍衬出轻盈腰身与修长美腿，黑色长袜勾勒出优美腿型。她单手支着案上的账本，另一手拈着毛笔笔杆点在唇间，面颊带着浅浅微醺的绯红，梅花眸中波光荡漾——「哎呀，今晚的账本好像怎么算都不对……要不，你亲自过来帮本堂主核对一遍？」
data.location: 往生堂红木书案边缘长椅旁
data.action: 端坐红木书案边，单腿轻踩脚踏，一手撑桌一手持毛笔抵唇，歪头笑睨观众
data.lighting: 书案红烛暖光与窗外竹影月华
data.camera: front view, eye level, cowboy shot
data.mood: 少女堂主工作之余的俏皮调侃与亲密
data.promptProse: Hu Tao perches atop a polished redwood desk inside Wangsheng Funeral Parlor at night, wearing crimson-and-black lace lingerie with a butterfly clasp, garter straps, and black stockings. Bracing one hand on the desk edge while touching a calligraphy brush to her lips with a playful blush, she gazes directly at the viewer in warm red candlelight.
data.nsfwProse: She wears crimson-and-black lace lingerie fastened with a butterfly clasp, matching red panties, garter straps, and sheer black stockings.
data.animaCaption: Seated atop the redwood parlor desk facing the viewer in crimson-and-black lace lingerie and black stockings, she props one foot on the footrest and tilts her head with a teasing brush against her lips. Warm red candlelight glows across the antique scrolls behind her.
